verdict.rationale: Moneybird documents an MCP server, CLI and REST API that let AI clients connect, but nothing in the evidence covers bank-transaction matching, flagging reconciliation exceptions, or preparing a month-end close for human review. Generic agent connectivity is only a developer building block, not the reconciliation capability itself.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent reconcile a month end-to-end, matching transactions, flagging exceptions, and preparing the close for human review
